source_text: Even within intactivist circles, the comic's heavy-handed moral binaries—heroes solely anti-circumcision, villains pro—have drawn rebuke for selective emphasis on harms while sidelining countervailing data, such as randomized trials showing 60% HIV acquisition reduction in heterosexual men from adult voluntary circumcision, potentially hindering coalition-building with public health advocates. [75]
